text: The reputation systems of SingularityNET, Fetch.ai, Ocean Protocol, Numeraire, and DcentAI are structurally insufficient for a fully decentralized Mechanical Turk model of large-scale AI dataset creation, offering only incremental innovation.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Artificial Intelligence The Final Frontier (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5095633
abstract: While these platforms offer incremental innovations in how contributors are evaluated and rewarded, they remain structurally insufficient for a fully decentralized "Mechanical Turk" model of large-scale AI dataset creation.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: highly contextual, iterative, and ethically sensitive dataset tasks
continuous compliance with evolving legal standards
